text: {"labels": [{"claim_id": "c11", "label": "S", "reason": "[8] states pack-refs renders repo unclonable over dumb transports by Git before 1.5.1.2."}, {"claim_id": "c5", "label": "C", "reason": "[10] says git gc calls worktree prune --expire 3.months.ago, not 3.weeks.ago."}, {"claim_id": "c6", "label": "C", "reason": "[7] gives exception: git gc --auto runs if gc.log is older than gc.logExpiry."}, {"claim_id": "c9", "label": "S", "reason": "[7] states default gc.logExpiry is \"1.day\", i.e. one day."}, {"claim_id": "c1", "label": "S", "reason": "[5] says gc.autoDetach default is true, returning immediately and running in background when supported."}, {"claim_id": "c4", "label": "C", "reason": "[1] says --prune=now increases corruption risk with concurrent writers, so it is not safest."}, {"claim_id": "c3", "label": "C", "reason": "[3] and [4] say gc.auto=0 disables gc.autoPackLimit too, so it is not left active."}]}
